QuestInfo.name: Third Evan Launch Gift from the Admin
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Admin has prepared a gift for you to celebrate the launch of Evan. If you're curious about the gift, talk to the Maple Admin.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Admin has prepared 5 different cash items that look especially good on Evan. You can get the third item from the Maple Admin when you reach Lv. 19.
QuestInfo.2: You have received your third Evan Launch Gift from the Admin.

0.0: Hello, this is the Maple Admin. Congratulations on reaching Lv. 19. I see Mir has gotten stronger, too. Are you curious what my third gift is?

yes.0: Please come see me when you're ready to receive my third gift.

no.0: It's a special gift that will be given out only until May 4th, so hurry over if you want it!
